title: Enlarging a local presentability rank
statement: Fix a universe $\mathcal U$ and an ordinary category $\mathcal C$ with $\mathcal U$-small Hom sets. Small diagrams and colimits are relative to $\mathcal U$, with colimits as in [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. An infinite cardinal $\eta$ is regular if a union of fewer than $\eta$ sets, each of size less than $\eta$, has size less than $\eta$. A category is $\eta$-filtered if every diagram with fewer than $\eta$ morphisms has a cocone. An object $P$ is $\eta$-presentable if $\operatorname{Hom}(P,-)$ preserves all small $\eta$-filtered colimits. A category is locally $\eta$-presentable if it has all small colimits and a small family of $\eta$-presentable objects such that every object is a small $\eta$-filtered colimit of members of this family. If $\kappa\leq\tau$ are infinite regular cardinals in $\mathcal U$ and $\mathcal C$ is locally $\kappa$-presentable, then $\mathcal C$ is locally $\tau$-presentable.
